name: @w6w-apps/instapaper
description: Save, organize and read articles with Instapaper — bookmarks, folders and highlights over its OAuth 1.0a xAuth API.

w6w.longDescription:
Instapaper is a read-it-later service: save an article's URL and read a clean, distraction-free text version of it later, across devices. This app covers Instapaper's Full API (`instapaper.com/developers`, its older but still-live and unchanged REST surface, verified against two live snapshots seven months apart) — the complete documented method set for bookmarks (list, add, delete, star/unstar, archive/unarchive, move, update reading progress, get the processed text view), folders (list, add, delete, reorder) and highlights (list, create, delete).

Authentication is Instapaper's xAuth: a server-to-server exchange of the user's Instapaper username/password for a long-lived OAuth 1.0a access token, signed with an app-level consumer key/secret Instapaper issues after a manual review. Every request after that is signed with OAuth 1.0a (HMAC-SHA1) — there is no bearer token or API key. Instapaper documents no token expiry and no refresh endpoint, so the exchanged token is used as-is; the account password is not retained.

Instapaper publishes no vendor status page (status.instapaper.com does not resolve; instapaper.statuspage.io is an unclaimed decoy) — the health check states that absence explicitly, and the derived credential check (`account/verify_credentials`) is the working signal for "is this connection live".
